topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: I had just settled in for a quiet afternoon, grading papers and reflecting on the week, when I noticed a small, unassuming package on my desk. It wasn’t wrapped elaborately or adorned with ribbons, just a simple box with my name neatly written on top. I carefully opened it, curious about its contents. Inside, I found a beautifully crafted frame holding a photograph of my old classroom, the one where I'd spent so many years. Alongside it was a heartfelt note. The handwriting was familiar—it was from Sarah, one of my students from years ago. She thanked me for believing in her, for pushing her to reach a little further when she thought she couldn’t. The weight of the frame in my hands felt like more than just a gift; it was a piece of my legacy, a tangible reminder of the impact we have, often without realizing it.
